programs=p.parent
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Replace color 5 with the other non-background color; erase that color."""
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    if 5 not in colors:
        raise ValueError("expected anchor color 5")
    others = colors - {5, 0}
    if len(others) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected exactly one other foreground color")
    target = next(iter(others))
    return [[target if value == 5 else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
'''
